summary: Episode 23: At dawn the traveler prepared to leave for good. Salim gave him a freshly copied book and a rolled chart of the wider world as a parting gift, and the family walked him to the city gate to see him off toward the horizon. He carries their knowledge and kindness onward into the world. Tariq has grown from a curious boy into a young man of knowledge and mercy. Noor still doesn't know who leaves the gifts at her door.
open_threads: Noor still doesn't know who leaves the anonymous gifts at her door (Tariq knows it is Salim)
